# netactuate_virtual_server_contract (Data Source)

Reads a Virtual Server Contract.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_virtual_server_contract" "example" {
  mbpkgid = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mbpkgid` (Number) Server package ID whose virtual server contract should be read.

### Read-Only

- `allow_overage` (Number) Allow overage flag.
- `brand` (String) Contract brand.
- `contract_id` (Number) Contract usage record ID from the API field named id.
- `contract_mbpkgid` (Number) Contract package ID.
- `contract_type` (String) Contract type.
- `customer_description` (String) Customer description.
- `customer_po` (String) Customer purchase order.
- `hourly_discount` (Number) Hourly discount percentage.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `include_bandwidth` (Number) Included bandwidth flag.
- `is_free` (Number) Free contract flag.
- `max_cpus` (Number) Maximum CPUs.
- `max_disk` (Number) Maximum disk.
- `max_ram` (Number) Maximum RAM.
- `mb_id` (Number) Account ID.
- `monthly_discount` (Number) Monthly discount percentage.
- `parent_contract_id` (Number) Parent contract ID.
- `po_monthly_limit` (Number) Purchase order monthly limit.
